rows.en: Support Nadesico B
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Defeat enemy forces
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Achieve a 120-second Chain
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: An emergency call has come in from the <pic(0)><cs(3)>Nadesico B<ce()>, which is out on its pursuit mission.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: <mk(37.5,-75,5,1)><mk(75,-37.5,5,1,50)><mk(75,-75,5,1,100)>At the <cs(1)>Hisago Plan<ce()>'s main terminal colony, <pic(1)><cs(3)>Amaterasu<ce()>, a coup has broken out.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: Calling themselves the Martian Successors, they've seized Amaterasu's central systems.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: <mk(37.5,-37.5,5,3,50)><ar(0,5,3,150)>The Nadesico B was there studying the E2, but seems to have been caught in the coup.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: <mk(-50,12.5,1,3,100)><ar(0,1,3,200)><mk(-12.5,50,1,3,100)><ar(0,1,3,200)>The ship is fighting alongside the UCE's United Space Force and has requested support.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: <mk(50,37.5,0,0,50)><ar(0,0,0,150)>We will now change course for Amaterasu and move to support the Nadesico B.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: We know very little about the enemy forces. Be extremely careful.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: This is Misumaru of the <cs(1)>United Space Force<ce()>. I thank you for your cooperation.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: But despite our efforts, Amaterasu has been occupied by the <cs(1)>Martian Successors<ce()>.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: By destroying the Chulips all at once, we did manage to cut Amaterasu off, but
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: Amaterasu's Ruins Unit was taken to the enemy base, Iwato, ruins at Mars's polar cap.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: At this rate, they will gain what they were after: control of the <cs(1)>Boson Jump<ce()>.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: That would mean free jumps through space become possible.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: ...I trust you understand how serious a situation that would be.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: Getting an E2 back this time is a step forward for the UCE's mission, but
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: that is not the only thing that needs watching. I want you to keep that in mind.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: ...And one more thing: be wary of Dermail. His methods are a bit too heavy-handed...
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: Well then, I wish you all the best. Until we meet again.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: I had heard of your exploits, so I find this outcome truly regrettable.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru
